meaning:
θεοστυγής, -ές
(θεός, στυγέω),
1. passive, as frequently in cl., hateful to God: Rom.1:30 (R, txt., cf. Lit., Notes, 256).
2. Active, hating God: lb. (R, mg., cf. ICC, in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
